question: Which BIMSTEC members are NOT participating in China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI)?
solution:
The correct answer is I__**ndia and Bhutan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• ** India and Bhutan** are the only BIMSTEC members that are not participating in China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• India has opposed the BRI, particularly due to concerns about the **China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC)**,\

 
 
• which passes through the disputed region of **Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK)**. India views this as a violation of its sovereignty.
 
 
 
• Bhutan is also not part of the BRI.
 
• It has no formal diplomatic relations with China and maintains a cautious approach due to its territorial disputes with China and its strong relationship with India.
 
• The remaining BIMSTEC members — **Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar,** and **Thailand** — are participants in China's BRI to varying extents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation)**

 
 
• BIMSTEC was established in **1997** with the aim of promoting regional cooperation and development.
 
• The organization consists of **seven member countries**: **Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Myanmar, Sri Lanka,** and **Thailand**.
 
• These nations share geographical, economic, and cultural ties.
 
• BIMSTEC aims to enhance cooperation in various sectors, including trade, investment, technology, energy, transport, tourism, and agriculture.
 
• The member countries are located around the **Bay of Bengal**, which is strategically significant for trade routes and regional security.
